newsitem.title: ITALY: SPEED SKATING-OLYMPIC CHAMPION FAGONE HAS LEG AMPUTATED.
newsitem.headline: SPEED SKATING-OLYMPIC CHAMPION FAGONE HAS LEG AMPUTATED.

text.p: Italy's 1994 Olympic speed skating gold medallist Orazio Fagone had part of his right leg amputated on Friday after a motorcycle accident last month.

Hospital doctors in the northern city of Turin said Fagone, who helped Italy win the 5,000 metres short track relay title in Lillehammer, might also need to have part of his left leg amputated as well.
Fagone was seriously injured on May 30 near the town of Aosta when his bike crashed on a curve in the road and he went under the wheels of a truck.
The 28-year-old had set several short track world records both as an individual and with the relay team.
